camera_directive: Static ground-level close shot on his boot and the hem of his mantle
action: The tip of his black boot slowly lowers onto the surface and touches it without sinking, as if he weighs nothing; rings of ripples spread outward from the point of contact, and the hem of his mantle and robes sways with the motion
setting: A vast, mirror-smooth surface of liquid light stretching to the horizon, reflecting a pale luminous sky

camera_directive: Slow low-angle shot looking up at him against a bright sky
action: He stands on the surface as if hovering just above it, hands clasped behind his back, while ripples keep spreading beneath his feet and his robes and mantle drift slowly; strong light behind him keeps his face hidden in deep shadow
setting: A vast, mirror-smooth surface of liquid light stretching to the horizon, reflecting a pale luminous sky

action: His face emerges from shadow into soft light; his eyes are closed, then slowly open, revealing a calm, confident, impassive gaze
setting: A pale luminous sky behind him, faint rings of light rippling below
